Description: A high-level mobile automation engine designed to execute configurable social media workflows across real Android devices with large-scale parallel execution.
Architecture: Centralized control dashboard for configuration and monitoring
Distributed execution across connected Android devices
Automation powered by Appium, ADB, and UIAutomator
Core Engine: High-level action abstraction layer (tap, scroll, type, gesture simulation)
Support for multiple automation modes (standard and high-speed)
UI Detection System: Multi-layer fallback strategy for dynamic UI handling
Core Features: Automated engagement workflows (likes, follows, comments, interactions)
Automation Engine: Human-like interaction modeling (gesture variation, timing randomness)
Retry mechanism with up to 10 recovery attempts
AI Integration: Optional AI-based content generation (comments and messages)
Context-aware text generation using external API integration
Performance Metrics: Supports 50+ accounts per device in controlled scenarios
Stable long-duration execution under high load
Challenges: Designing a generic UI abstraction layer across diverse applications
Maintaining stability across multiple Android versions
Handling dynamic and frequently changing UI structures
